title_en: The Qur'anic Methodology in Inviting to the Truth
description_en: Excerpts from the program (Debates in Creed), selections on the stations of the Chosen One (peace be upon him and his family), episode 13: The legitimacy of seeking intercession through the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in his life and after his death, part 9, by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure).
summary: This clip examines the Qur'anic methodology for calling people to the truth.
series_en: Debates in Creed - Selections on the Stations of the Chosen One
